description: Test suite for Kubernetes DeploymentController, including tests for creating, updating, deleting deployments and replica sets, and handling pod events.

methods.name: rs
methods.description: Creates a ReplicaSet object with specified parameters.

methods.name: newRSWithStatus
methods.description: Creates a ReplicaSet with specified status.

methods.name: newDeployment
methods.description: Creates a Deployment object with specified parameters.

methods.name: newReplicaSet
methods.description: Creates a ReplicaSet owned by a Deployment.

methods.name: newFixture
methods.description: Initializes a test fixture for deployment controller tests.

methods.name: newController
methods.description: Creates a new DeploymentController with informers and fake client.

methods.name: runExpectError
methods.description: Runs the controller sync expecting an error.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the controller sync expecting no error.

methods.name: run_
methods.description: Internal method to run the sync with options for starting informers and expecting errors.

methods.name: filterInformerActions
methods.description: Filters out list/watch actions for pods, deployments, and replicasets from client actions.

methods.name: TestSyncDeploymentCreatesReplicaSet
methods.description: Test that syncing a deployment creates a new ReplicaSet.

methods.name: TestSyncDeploymentDontDoAnythingDuringDeletion
methods.description: Test that no action is taken during deployment deletion.

methods.name: TestSyncDeploymentDeletionRace
methods.description: Test handling of race condition during deployment deletion.

methods.name: TestDontSyncDeploymentsWithEmptyPodSelector
methods.description: Test that deployments with empty pod selectors are not synced.

methods.name: TestReentrantRollback
methods.description: Test that rollback logic is reentrant and idempotent.

methods.name: TestPodDeletionEnqueuesRecreateDeployment
methods.description: Test that pod deletion enqueues recreate deployment.

methods.name: TestPodDeletionDoesntEnqueueRecreateDeployment
methods.description: Test that pod deletion does not enqueue recreate deployment if other pods exist.

methods.name: TestPodDeletionPartialReplicaSetOwnershipEnqueueRecreateDeployment
methods.description: Test queuing on pod deletion with multiple replica sets, some with no owner references.

methods.name: TestPodDeletionPartialReplicaSetOwnershipDoesntEnqueueRecreateDeployment
methods.description: Test that no enqueue occurs when other pods are present.

methods.name: TestGetReplicaSetsForDeployment
methods.description: Test retrieval of replica sets for a deployment.

methods.name: TestGetReplicaSetsForDeploymentAdoptRelease
methods.description: Test adoption and release of replica sets for a deployment.

methods.name: TestGetPodMapForReplicaSets
methods.description: Test mapping pods to replica sets.

methods.name: TestAddReplicaSet
methods.description: Test adding a replica set to the deployment controller.

methods.name: TestAddReplicaSetOrphan
methods.description: Test adding an orphaned replica set.

methods.name: TestUpdateReplicaSet
methods.description: Test updating a replica set triggers enqueue.

methods.name: TestUpdateReplicaSetOrphanWithNewLabels
methods.description: Test updating labels on orphaned replica set.

methods.name: TestUpdateReplicaSetChangeControllerRef
methods.description: Test changing controller reference on replica set.

methods.name: TestUpdateReplicaSetRelease
methods.description: Test releasing a replica set from a deployment.

methods.name: TestDeleteReplicaSet
methods.description: Test deleting a replica set enqueues the correct deployment.

methods.name: TestDeleteReplicaSetOrphan
methods.description: Test deleting an orphaned replica set does not enqueue deployment.

methods.name: BenchmarkGetPodMapForDeployment
methods.description: Benchmark for getPodMapForDeployment method.

methods.name: bumpResourceVersion
methods.description: Increments the resource version of a metav1.Object.

methods.name: generatePodFromRS
methods.description: Creates a pod object based on a ReplicaSet's selector and template.
